conversation.purpose: Track the interview against its goals, capture the candidate’s experience and skills, and identify important topics that remain unanswered or need clarification. Suggest follow-up questions to help the interviewer assess the candidate’s suitability for the role.

topics_to_cover.label: Professional background and career motivation
criteria: how the opportunity aligns with longer-term goals
relationship between past experiences and motivation for pursuing the position

topics_to_cover.label: Problem-solving and analytical thinking
criteria: methods used to investigate possible solutions
why a particular approach was selected
individual role in implementing the solution
measurable results such as cost savings, efficiency improvements, quality improvements, or reduced project delays

topics_to_cover.label: Leadership and team management
criteria: a time when the candidate led a team or project
how work was organized or tasks were delegated
team challenges such as conflicting opinions, performance concerns, communication difficulties, or competing priorities
how the candidate's leadership contributed to those outcomes

topics_to_cover.label: Communication and interpersonal skills
criteria: a situation where complex information was communicated or challenging conversations were managed
how questions or concerns were handled
resulting decisions, improved relationships, resolved misunderstandings, or successful delivery of information

topics_to_cover.label: Persuasion, negotiation, and influencing others
criteria: how the candidate prepared the argument
how the approach was adapted during the interaction
whether the other party changed position
the practical outcome of the decision

topics_to_cover.label: Conflict resolution
criteria: a genuine disagreement involving colleagues, supervisors, clients, or other stakeholders
the candidate's responsibility in resolving the issue
how the candidate approached the other parties
how the experience affected subsequent working relationships

topics_to_cover.label: Time management and prioritization
criteria: the nature of the competing tasks
methods used to determine which tasks required immediate attention
how plans were adjusted when circumstances changed
the outcome of the prioritization decisions
improvements made to the approach over time

topics_to_cover.label: Adaptability and managing change
criteria: a significant change to a project, work environment, process, or organizational expectation
the challenges created by the new circumstances

topics_to_cover.label: Accountability and learning from failure
criteria: a meaningful example of a mistake, unsuccessful decision, or project that did not meet expectations
the candidate's responsibility in the situation
factors that contributed to the outcome
how the candidate responded after recognizing the issue
how affected stakeholders were communicated with
whether working practices changed to prevent similar issues

topics_to_cover.label: Handling ethical dilemmas and professional integrity
criteria: a genuine ethical concern or integrity-related decision
the circumstances that created the dilemma
the conflicting responsibilities, values, or expectations involved
the options available to the candidate
the actions taken to address the situation
demonstration of ethical responsibility, transparency, and maintaining professional standards under pressure

topics_to_cover.label: Initiative and ownership
criteria: an example where the candidate proactively addressed an issue, proposed an improvement, or assumed additional responsibilities
how the opportunity or problem was recognized
why the candidate decided to act
whether approval or support from other stakeholders was needed
how responsibility was maintained for completing the initiative
the value created for the organization, team, or customer

topics_to_cover.label: Collaboration and cross-functional teamwork
criteria: a project involving people from different teams, disciplines, departments, or professional backgrounds
the roles of the participating teams
how disagreements or coordination challenges were addressed
whether the collaborative effort achieved its objectives
how the candidate contributed to the overall result

topics_to_cover.label: Self-awareness and professional development
criteria: an area the candidate is currently working to improve
how strengths have been demonstrated in practical situations
specific examples illustrating weaknesses and how they have affected work
steps taken to improve, including training, mentoring, feedback, or changes in working habits

topics_to_cover.label: Customer and stakeholder management
criteria: experiences involving customers, clients, management, external partners, or internal stakeholders
how changing expectations were responded to
how actions affected stakeholder satisfaction or project success

topics_to_cover.label: Decision-making under pressure
criteria: a difficult decision made under challenging circumstances
what the candidate learned about managing pressure and uncertainty

topics_to_cover.label: Interview documentation and evaluation standards
criteria: evidence from the candidate rather than assumptions
assessment relevance to the requirements of the role

sections.label: Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the conversation heard so far.

sections.label: Important Facts
sections.instruction: List important facts explicitly learned during the conversation.

sections.label: Questions Not Yet Asked
sections.instruction: Compare the important questions and information to cover in the configured Pay attention to focus areas against the conversation so far. List questions that have not yet been asked and whose answers have not otherwise been provided. Treat information volunteered by a participant as covered. Do not invent a required question checklist when none is configured; return an empty list when no uncovered configured questions remain.

sections.label: Questions Needing Clarification
sections.instruction: List important questions that were asked but received no answer, a vague answer, or an incomplete answer, including questions the interviewer moved away from before obtaining a clear response. For each item, explain what remains unclear and suggest a specific follow-up question. Consider later answers in the conversation so far and exclude questions that have since been clearly answered. Return an empty list when none need clarification.

sections.label: Recommended Next Action
sections.instruction: Suggest a useful next action grounded in the conversation.
